etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From French malingrer, from adjective malingre (“delicate, fragile”).
senses: (ambitransitive) To feign illness, injury, or incapacitation in order to avoid work, obligation, or perilous risk.
(ambitransitive) To self-inflict real injury or infection (to inflict self-harm) in order to avoid work, obligation, or perilous risk.
